text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Agumon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait: Cost 2

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Raid＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name or the [ME] or [VB] trait from your trash to the hand.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
